title: A member of Congress saw a UFO come out of a lake while fishing with his son

tellings.quote: I go to Congress and and members of Congress will pull me aside and said look I had my own UFO sighting with my son literally fishing in in in a lake and the thing came out of the water

plain: A member of the US Congress is said to have been fishing on a lake with his son when an unidentified object came up out of the water. Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, says members of Congress have taken him aside to tell him such things, and repeats this one without naming the member. If true, it would mean lawmakers themselves have had sightings.
